summary: Diff adds all seven requested premium interactive sections as reusable React components under frontend/src/components/sections, backed by a new curated English-only content module, and integrates them into existing pages (Home/Story/Gallery). Reduced-motion handling is used throughout via usePrefersReducedMotion and motion classes largely rely on opacity/transform transitions. One key accessibility requirement (focus trap for the Polaroid modal) is not evidenced, and voice-note volume/fade integration with the existing music system is not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Voice Note Messages section should have smooth fade/volume behavior aligned with the existing music system.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows per-note playback created via `new Audio(audioPath)` with play/pause and timeupdate listeners, but no evidence of coordinating volume/fade with the existing BackgroundMusicProvider/music system.

missing_requirements.requirement: Polaroid Love Wall expanded view (if modal) traps focus appropriately.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff evidences a modal-like dialog (role="dialog", aria-modal, Escape-to-close, overlay click-to-close) but does not show any focus-trap implementation (e.g., focus sent into modal, tab cycling, restoring focus on close).
